label: Jazz
blueprintGuidance: Represent jazz: harmonic color, spacious phrasing, swing or brushed groove, and live-room intimacy.
Keep the vocal melody central and avoid turning the track into a long instrumental showcase.
Use mood input for bar, rain, midnight, noir, warm, or lonely details.
generationGuidance: Use brushed drums, upright or warm electric bass, piano or Rhodes, soft ride cymbal, and optional muted horn or sax fills.
Use tasteful 7th or 9th chord color while keeping the form accessible.
Leave space between phrases and keep instrumental fills shorter than the vocal hook.
For short-form output, start close to the main vocal section rather than a long lounge intro.
avoidGuidance: Avoid bebop complexity, fast walking bass, busy solos, or scatting.
Avoid EDM pads, pop-rock drums, and bright synth leads.
